title: All the biggest news from AWS’ big tech show re:Invent 2025
description: Amazon Web Services' giant tech conference re:Invent 2025 is happening this week with news ranging from chips to AI services.
author: Kirsten Korosec, Julie Bort, Rebecca Szkutak

title: Meta poaches Apple design exec Alan Dye to lead new creative studio in Reality Labs
description: Dye led Apple's user interface team for the last decade.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Andy Jassy says Amazon’s Nvidia competitor chip is already a multibillion-dollar business
description: Can any company, big or small, really topple Nvidia's AI chip dominance? Maybe not entirely, but Amazon is already making big bucks trying.
author: Julie Bort

title: WordPress’s vibe-coding experiment, Telex, has already been put to real-world use
description: Though WordPress's Telex is still an experiment, the vibe-coding software has already been used to help build real-world websites.
author: Sarah Perez

title: VCs deploy ‘kingmaking’ strategy to crown AI winners in their infancy
description: While VCs have long used big investments to spur category winners, they are taking this strategy to new extremes.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Anthropic hires lawyers as it preps for IPO
description: Anthropic is reportedly prepping for an IPO that could come as early as 2026.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: AWS doubles down on custom LLMs with features meant to simplify model creation
description: AWS is launching more capabilities in both Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker AI to make building custom models easier.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Another bid to block state AI regulation has failed… for now
description: Republicans’ attempt to ban state AI regulations was removed from the defense bill after bipartisan opposition, underscoring tensions between tech-industry demands, consumer protection concerns, and Trump’s push for sweeping federal preemption.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google Photos’ 2025 Recap turns to Gemini to find your highlights
description: The Google Photos Recap will use Gemini's AI to find your memorable moments throughout the year, and adds new metrics, like a 'selfie' count.
author: Sarah Perez

title: All the biggest news from AWS’ big tech show re:Invent 2025
description: Amazon Web Services giant tech conference is happening this week with news ranging from chips to AI services.
author: Rebecca Szkutak, Julie Bort, Kirsten Korosec

title: Amazon challenges competitors with on-premises Nvidia ‘AI Factories’
description: If the product name sounds familiar, it should. It's a collab with Nvidia that combines AWS tech with the chip maker's tech.
author: Julie Bort

title: Google tests merging AI Overviews with AI Mode
description: Google is testing how to make it easier to move from search to an AI chat in a new global test.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Amazon previews 3 AI agents, including ‘Kiro’ that can code on its own for days
description: Amazon Web Services on Tuesday announced three new AI agents it calls "Frontier agents" for coding, security, and DevOps.
author: Julie Bort

title: Android 16 adds AI notification summaries, new customization options, and more
description: The rollout of the new Android 16 features, which are first coming to Pixel devices, marks a new chapter in how Android updates work, as the company is shifting from a single yearly update to more frequent releases.
author: Aisha Malik

title: ChatGPT referrals to retailers’ apps increased 28% year-over-year, says report
description: ChatGPT referrals to retailers' apps were up on Black Friday year-over-year, with Walmart and Amazon benefiting the most.
author: Sarah Perez

title: AWS launches new Nova AI models and a service that gives customers more control
description: Amazon Web Services announced four new AI models within its Nova model family and a frontier model service.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: OpenAI slammed for app suggestions that looked like ads
description: OpenAI clarified that the app suggestion was not an advertisement, but instead a poor attempt to integrate an app discovery feature within conversations.
author: Sarah Perez

title: AWS re:Invent 2025: How to watch and follow along live
description: Amazon Web Services’ big annual event, re:Invent 2025, is getting into full swing in Las Vegas this week, and you can follow the keynotes live right here.
author: Morgan Little

title: AWS announces new capabilities for its AI agent builder
description: AWS is introducing new capabilities for its AI agent-building platform, including memory and evaluation tools.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Amazon releases an impressive new AI chip and teases an Nvidia-friendly roadmap
description: AWS has been building its own AI chips — and systems — for years now. It just released its third version, known as Trainium3, with some impressive specs.
author: Julie Bort

title: Simular’s AI agent wants to run your Mac, Windows PC for you
description: Simular, a startup building AI agents for Mac OS and Windows, has solved the AI hallucination problem in a compelling way.
author: Julie Bort

title: Mistral closes in on Big AI rivals with new open-weight frontier and small models
description: Mistral unveils its Mistral 3 lineup, including a frontier model and efficient small models designed for offline, customizable enterprise use — aiming to prove small, fine-tuned AI can beat closed-source giants.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Paris-based AI voice startup Gradium nabs $70M seed
description: Gradium, a startup spawned out of French AI lab Kyutai (backed by French telecom billionaire Xavier Niel), launched out of stealth on Tuesday.
author: Julie Bort

title: What does it mean when Uncle Sam is one of your biggest shareholders? Chip startup xLight is about to find out
description: You can imagine how this is all going over in Silicon Valley, where the libertarian ethos runs deep.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Apple just named a new AI chief with Google and Microsoft expertise, as John Giannandrea steps down
description: His replacement is Amar Subramanya, a highly regarded Microsoft executive who spent 16 years at Google, most recently leading engineering for the Gemini Assistant. It's a savvy hire, given that Subramanya knows the competition intimately.
author: Connie Loizos

title: One of Google’s biggest AI advantages is what it already knows about you
description: The promise is AI that's uniquely helpful because it knows you. But the risk is AI that feels more like surveillance than service.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Nvidia announces new open AI models and tools for autonomous driving research
description: Nvidia continues its push into physical AI with the release of a new reasoning world model and other tools for physical AI.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: AWS re:Invent 2025: How to watch and follow along live
description: Amazon Web Services’ big annual event, re:Invent 2025, is getting into full swing in Las Vegas this week, and you can follow the keynotes live right here.
author: Morgan Little

title: Construction workers are cashing in on the AI boom
description: "I pinch myself going to work every day," one 51-year-old says of his new supervisor role overseeing 200 workers at a data center site.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Data center energy demand forecasted to soar nearly 300% through 2035
description: New planned data centers promise to consume even more energy than expected. Meanwhile, a grid monitor is blaming such growth for high electricity prices.
author: Tim De Chant
